shaSeparation.reviewedCandidateNote: Codex E5 Round 2 reviewed this exact SHA and issued FINAL VERDICT: PASS. 3 distinct adversarial findings closed across 1 review round: R1-01 WeakSet integrity canary / R1-02 Object.freeze canary + exact own-keys + nested frozen verifier / R1-03 ignore injected verifier deps + closed outcomeClass allowlist.

contractEnforcements.viewmodelScope: renderer/js/r3-0e-experiment-viewmodel.js exports createExperimentViewmodel({classifier, timelineModule}) + verifyAuthoritativeViewmodelState. Returns frozen service api with derive/empty/error/stale methods. Each returned state is deep-frozen, registered in a closure-private WeakSet, and exposes displayState ∈ {unavailable, loading, available, stale-cleared, error-sanitized}.
contractEnforcements.noServiceInversion: Viewmodel NEVER classifies, NEVER calls back into classifier.classifyOutcome, NEVER appends timeline events, NEVER creates follow-up links. It ONLY accepts already-authoritative outputs and maps them to display state. Any non-authoritative input → error-sanitized state.
contractEnforcements.activationGate: derive() returns activation.uiCapabilityReady = true iff BOTH an authoritative outcome AND an authoritative projection are present; otherwise false with deferredCapabilities populated. featureRegistryActivationAllowed mirrors uiCapabilityReady. rationaleI18nKey switches between r3.0e.activation.ready / r3.0e.activation.deferred / case_required / applied_experiment_required.
contractEnforcements.i18nParity: i18n-r3-0e.js carries en + zh-TW + ja keys for every nav label, feature label, outcome class, timeline kind, display state, activation rationale, and disclaimers — all three languages contain the SAME set of keys (tests/i18n-parity.test.js enforces).
contractEnforcements.featureRegistry: feature-registry.js adds 2 NAV_NODES (case:experiment_loop order=9 + case:case_timeline order=10) and 2 FEATURES (experiment_loop + case_timeline, case_scoped, available_conditional, mounted on the analysis pane). Activation completes when E5_ACTIVATION's governance flag goes true.
contractEnforcements.disclaimers: Every authoritative viewmodel state carries the four R3.0E disclaimers as a frozen array (no_causation / no_driver_blame / no_auto_setup / same_case_session_only). UI host code MUST render at least one disclaimer alongside any outcome display.
contractEnforcements.stateFloors: E5 unlocks uiAllowed=true AND featureRegistryActivationAllowed=true. algorithmsAllowed remains true (unchanged from E3/E4). R3.0B case-record schema NOT modified.
